sentences.en: The spacecraft was launched atop a reusable SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket.
sentences.zh: 1. 这艘航天器是由可重复使用的SpaceX猎鹰9号火箭发射升空的。

sentences.en: Twig in beak, the diminutive bird pranced atop the thick branch.
sentences.zh: 2. 小鸟嘴里叼着树枝，在粗壮的枝干上轻快地跳来跳去。

sentences.en: I admire the view of the entire city atop the Ferris wheel.
sentences.zh: 3. 我从摩天轮顶部欣赏整个城市的美景。
